summary: A cleaned, enriched CSV of all ~28,000 US FDA-registered medical device establishment sites — manufacturers, distributors, importers, and contract sterilizers — extracted from the FDA's public Device Registration & Listing bulk download. Fields include establishment name, city, state, ZIP, FDA registration number, proprietary name list, device class, and product codes. No competitor currently sells this as an affordable standalone flat file: the primary incumbents (Advex Medical, MedTechIntelligence) charge $2,000–$8,000/year for SaaS wrapped around the same government source. A $69 one-time Gumroad CSV undercuts all incumbents and serves the long tail of medical device sales reps, healthcare GPO analysts, and medtech startup founders who need a prospect list without an enterprise contract.

audience.who: Medical device sales reps and regional distributors building territory prospect lists of hospitals and device facilities; medtech startup founders doing competitive landscape and market sizing; hospital group purchasing organizations (GPOs) evaluating supplier rosters; healthcare IT and compliance software vendors (QMS, MDR, UDI compliance tools) prospecting for new device manufacturer clients; investment analysts tracking US medical device manufacturing concentration by state.

data_wanted: FDA Device Registration & Listing bulk export. Fields: establishment name, owner/operator name, city, state, ZIP, country, FDA registration number (FEI), registration expiration date, US agent name (for foreign establishments), proprietary device names listed under each registration, device class (I/II/III), product code, submission type (510k/PMA/De Novo), and establishment operations (manufacturer, distributor, importer, contract sterilizer, contract manufacturer). Available as downloadable ZIP/JSON/CSV from the FDA Open Data Portal with no authentication required. Direct download: https://open.fda.gov/data/res/ — the 'device/registrationlisting' endpoint exports the full dataset. Also accessible at https://www.fda.gov/medical-devices/registration-and-listing-medical-devices/download-device-registration-and-listing-data.

willingness_to_pay.signal: The medical device prospect data market is active and enterprise-priced. Advex Medical charges $250–$500/month ($3,000–$6,000/year) for territory prospect lists built from FDA public data. MedTechIntelligence and similar platforms run $2,000–$8,000/year. Independent medical device sales reps — the largest underserved segment — cannot justify enterprise pricing to build their own territory lists. A $69 one-time CSV delivers exactly the same government-source establishment data at a 97% discount. LinkedIn communities for medical device reps (r/MedicalDeviceSales, 15k members; Med Device Summit Slack groups) confirm reps routinely discuss the difficulty of affordable prospect data.
